title: geoBoundaries Algeria (DZA) ADM0 and ADM1 Boundaries (gbOpen)
description: Open administrative boundary polygons for Algeria from the geoBoundaries database (William & Mary geoLab): the national outline (ADM0, 1 unit) and first-level units (ADM1, 48 wilayas), both sourced from OpenStreetMap (Wambacher extract) and representing the year 2017.
purpose: Openly licensed national and wilaya outlines for clipping global datasets and aggregating statistics; note that the ADM1 layer reflects the pre-2019 48-wilaya division.
creator: geoBoundaries / William & Mary geoLab; boundary source: OpenStreetMap contributors (via wambachers-osm.website)

license.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0

license_notes: License for DZA ADM0 and ADM1 (gbOpen) as reported by the geoBoundaries API: 'Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0', licenseSource www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. This differs from the CC BY 4.0 stated generically on the geoBoundaries homepage; the per-boundary ODbL (share-alike for derived databases) applies. Attribute OpenStreetMap contributors and geoBoundaries (link to www.geoboundaries.org when used on the web).
citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0231866. Boundary data: geoBoundaries gbOpen DZA ADM0 (DZA-ADM0-9297773) and ADM1 (DZA-ADM1-43142294), source OpenStreetMap, Wambacher; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.

references.citation: Runfola, D., Anderson, A., Baier, H., Crittenden, M., et al. (2020). geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE, 15(4), e0231866.

spatial_extent.description: Algeria only (ADM0 national outline; ADM1 48 units with ISO 3166-2 codes DZ-01 to DZ-48).

temporal_extent.description: boundaryYearRepresented 2017 (ADM0 and ADM1); source data update date 19 Jan 2023; geoBoundaries build date 12 Dec 2023. Algeria officially had 58 wilayas from law 19-12 (2019; names fixed March 2021) and has 69 since law 26-06 of 4 April 2026, so this ADM1 layer is outdated (see research/wilaya_geography.md).

variables.name: shapeName
variables.description: Unit name (Latin script); 'Bordj Bou Arreridj' carries a trailing U+200E character in the ADM1 file

processing: geoBoundaries ingests boundaries from the cited source (here OpenStreetMap via the Wambacher boundaries extract), standardises attributes and geometry, and publishes full and simplified files with metadata through a versioned GitHub release and an API.
limitations: ADM1 represents the 48-wilaya configuration (year 2017), not the 58 (2019/2021) or 69 (2026) wilayas now in law.
boundaryCanonical is 'Unknown' and the source is crowd-sourced OSM, not an official Algerian cadastre; boundaries are not authoritative.
ODbL share-alike applies to derived databases.
geoBoundaries gbOpen DZA ADM2 is not a commune layer (48 units, Wikimedia Commons, 2012, Public Domain); use gbHumanitarian ADM2 (1,541 units, UNHCR/GAUL, CC BY 3.0 IGO) for communes.
algeria_notes: Label this layer '48 wilayas (pre-2019 configuration, OSM 2017)'. Algeria has 69 wilayas under law 26-06 (JO n° 25, 5 April 2026); no openly licensed 58- or 69-wilaya boundary file was found on 2026-11-19. Raw API responses are archived in research/geoboundaries_dza.json.

verification.notes: All metadata from the geoBoundaries 'current' API on 2026-11-19: boundarySource 'OpenStreetMap, Wambacher'; boundarySourceURL wambachers-osm.website/boundaries/; boundaryLicense ODbL 1.0; boundaryYearRepresented 2017; sourceDataUpdateDate 'Thu Jan 19 07:31:04 2023'; buildDate 'Dec 12, 2023'; admUnitCount ADM0 1, ADM1 48. gbAuthoritative/DZA returns 404. published_date = buildDate. Simplified ADM1 file inspected: 48 features, shapeISO DZ-01..DZ-48.

alert: This dataset represents Algeria's former 48-wilaya configuration (2017). Algeria has had 58 wilayas since 2019 and 69 since Loi n° 26-06 of 4 April 2026. For the current configuration, see the AEO boundary dataset (aeo-dza-admin-boundaries).
